text_block_list.name: Spe's Letter
text_block_list.text:
Dear Mom, You won't believe it, but I
entered a raffle they were holding in the
shopping district and won two
tickets for
a trip to Hokkaido!

text_block_list.name: Spe's Letter
text_block_list.text:
I'm planning to head home next
weekend, and I'll be bringing my friend
Suzuka! I wrote to you about her before,
remember? Anyway, see you
soon!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: We're finally here! I guess the road from the rest of Japan to Hokkaido is a long road!

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! It's always a joy to see you in
good spirits,
Spe! And welcome to
Hokkaido, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I know it's not going to be a long stay,
but I really
hope you'll enjoy it!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much, ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Look, Suzuka! This is the shopping
district where I
always used to go
grocery shopping with Mom!

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Spe adores the croquettes that store
sells. One time, she nearly burned her
mouth trying to eat
one whole because
it was so tasty.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Mooom! Don't tell her that story!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That plaza over there's where they hold
the big karaoke contest! Mom and I
once—whoa, hang
on! It looks super new
and shiny!

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
It was renovated recently. Now it's a
concert rehearsal space for people who
were inspired by your achievements and
want to follow in your
footsteps.

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
As you may know, we don't have many 
Umamusume around here. But I think
everyone wanted to support the few who
call this place
home.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh, I see. That's truly wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And next up... Ta-dah! It's my mom's
farm!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Wow... You oversee such a vast area? It
must be
hard.

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it is. Long ago, not only did I have
to deal with naughty calves, but also a
free-spirited
daughter who kept running
through the mud!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Eventually, I started running
through the
fields instead!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Over here, Suzuka! These are the fields I
was
talking about. Running through
them is the best
feeling in the world!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I can imagine. They're so spacious,
it feels
like you could run to the very
ends of the earth
from here!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Apparently, Mama used to love
running
here too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I run around and play in these
fields, it
feels like I'm running alongside
her.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I see... Um, if it's not too much to ask,
may I run
with you here as well?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'd love to! I bet that would
make
Mama really happy too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Are you ready? On your mark, get set...

text_block_list.name: Spe & Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Go!

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Walking around so much has made me
thirsty.
Sorry, Spe, but could you get us
some drinks,
please?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sure thing!

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Suzuka. Can I ask you how Spe's
been
doing? Is she handling herself
well?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes. She's bright and honest... I think
she's a very
strong individual.

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I see... Judging from your interactions
earlier, I'm
guessing you already know
that Spe had another
mother?

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Becoming the best racer in Japan wasn't
her dream, but her birth mother's. It's
not one she
should feel obligated to
shoulder.

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I've told her that over and over, but she
keeps insisting on becoming the best
racer in Japan in
order to make her birth
mother and me proud.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... I don't quite know how to explain
it, but I think Spe has always chased
after that dream of
her own volition, not
out of obligation.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
So please, don't worry. Spe always looks
like she's
having so much fun when she
runs.

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you. Spe is lucky to have a
friend like
you.

text_block_list.name: Spe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I hope you'll always remain by her side,
Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Phew! We finally made it back! So
Suzuka, what
did you think of
Hokkaido?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It was very fun. I learned a lot about you
too. It doesn't seem like you've changed
much from
when you were a child,
though.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
C'mon,
don't say that! I guess I'm still the
same
deep down, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I definitely changed after
coming to
Tracen and seeing you run,
Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
My rivals, my fans... All the different
people I've
met have given me the
opportunity to grow.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Some aspects of me have changed and some
remain the same. But it's the
combination of all
those things that
make me who I am today!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
That's very true. Allow me to rephrase
what I said.
You've certainly become a
lot more resolute.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I feel like I'll be able to see all
kinds of
different sights as long as I'm
with you, Spe.
